name: io.github.denshinji/play-console-mcp
title: Google Play Console
description: Google Play Console listings, releases, rollouts, reviews and vitals, with staged edits and guards

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_PACKAGE_NAMES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated package names the server may manage; the first is the default

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service account key (default ~/.config/play-console-mcp/service-account.json)

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_ASSET_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory that uploaded and synced files must live under (default: the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_ALLOW_PRODUCTION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow production track changes
